definitions.explanation: A postal service that provides tracking and proof of delivery for important items.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{書留|かきとめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}った→送る：00742_okuru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Important documents should be sent by registered mail.

examples.japanese: {書留|かきとめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦サインした→サインする：09864_sainsuru⟧。
examples.english: I signed for the package that arrived by registered mail.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧{書留|かきとめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送金|そうきん}した→送金：09774_soukin⟧。
examples.english: I sent money by cash registered mail.

notes:
{書留|かきとめ} is registered mail that provides tracking and requires signature upon delivery.

Types of registered mail in Japan:
- ⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧{書留|かきとめ} (regular registered mail)
- ⟦{簡易|かんい}→簡易：13804_kani⟧{書留|かきとめ} (simplified registered mail)
- ⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧{書留|かきとめ} (cash registered mail - for sending money)

Common expressions:
- {書留|かきとめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ (to send by registered mail)
- {書留|かきとめ}⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧ (registered mail fee)

The name comes from the fact that the mail is 'recorded' (⟦{書|か}き{留|と}める→書き留める：06730_kakitomeru⟧ = to write down/record).
